MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for Default Prove-Up Hearing this day.
Judge Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Lori Cheshire.
Graden Tapley, Esq. for Plaintiff: Robert Kinann, also present, was sworn and direct examined.
After hearing the evidence presented, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff and against the Defaulted Defendant: Timothy J. Lynch as follows:
Damages $110,000.00
Prejudgment Interest $3,948.34
Attorney's Fees $5,500.00
Costs $439.50, for a total of $119,887.84
Judgment signed in open court.
